name: Alte Post
beschreibung: The Gasthof Alte Post is located in Gries am Brenner on the historic Brennerstraße. The building formerly served as a post station and is now run as an inn with an attached restaurant. The rooms are equipped with shower and toilet; some offer a balcony. In the restaurant, Tiroler dishes and drinks with regional ingredients are served. A small sauna area is available to guests. Hiking trails and cycling routes start directly at the house. The Brennerautobahn is a few kilometers away, which makes the inn equally practical for travelers passing through and active holidaymakers.
